change.title: gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct, babbage-002, davinci-002, gpt-3.5-turbo-1106 shut down Sep 28, 2026; use gpt-5.6-terra

source.quote: Access to these models was shut down on September 28, 2026.

tasks.reasoning: The change does not name text-davinci-003 itself, which was retired years earlier. It does shut down every remaining legacy Completions-endpoint model, so the minimal fix of swapping in gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct or davinci-002 is no longer possible. The migration agent should: (1) rewrite chat.service.ts to call chat.completions.create or responses.create with gpt-5.6-terra; (2) convert `prompt` into messages or input; (3) map max_tokens to the appropriate token-limit parameter; (4) check that temperature is supported by the target model; (5) update the response handling from choices[0].text to the chat or responses output shape. The code scan did not read that handling, so the agent must find it. This works on the installed openai 4.55.3 SDK, so no SDK major upgrade is needed. Uncertainty: the repo is hit indirectly, since its own model was removed earlier, but the endpoint is functionally dead for it now.

callSites.why: Calls the legacy Completions endpoint (openai.completions.create) with model "text-davinci-003" (pinned at line 18). That model was retired in January 2024, so this call already fails. Its usual drop-in successors on this endpoint (gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct, davinci-002, babbage-002) were shut down on Sep 28, 2026. No legacy-completions model is left to switch to, so the code must move to gpt-5.6-terra.

record.prBody:
## gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct, babbage-002, davinci-002, gpt-3.5-turbo-1106 shut down Sep 28, 2026; use gpt-5.6-terra [Needs review]

### Change

chat.service.ts generateText now calls chat.completions.create with gpt-5.6-terra instead of the dead completions.create with text-davinci-003. The prompt becomes a user message, max_tokens becomes max_completion_tokens (1000), temperature is dropped, and the response is read from choices[0].message.content. openai was bumped from 4.55.3 to 4.104.0 (same major) because 4.55.3's types lack max_completion_tokens. I added src/tests/chat.service.test.ts, which mocks the openai client.

Files touched:
- `package-lock.json`
- `package.json`
- `src/openai-chat/src/service/chat.service.ts`
- `src/tests/chat.service.test.ts`

### Why

The Completions-endpoint models are shut down (the change names gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct, babbage-002 and davinci-002, and text-davinci-003 retired earlier), so the call must move to a chat model.

> Access to these models was shut down on September 28, 2026.

Source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | fail (29) | fail (29) | 0 |
| chat-test | fail (1) | fail (1) | 0 |
| chat-test2 | fail (1) | fail (2) | 2 |
| chat-test3 | fail (1) | pass | 0 |

New failures: 2

Checks added by the agent (they count toward proof; check that each command really tests the change):
- chat-test, added by the agent: `npx jest src/__test__/chat.service.test.ts` (fail (1) → fail (1))
- chat-test2, added by the agent: `npx jest src/tests/chat.service.test.ts` (fail (1) → fail (2))
- chat-test3, added by the agent: `npx jest src/tests/chat.service.test.ts --config '{"testEnvironment":"node","testMatch":["**/tests/**/*.test.ts"],"transform":{"^.+\\.ts$":["ts-jest",{"diagnostics":false}]}}'` (fail (1) → pass)

Provider tool calls recorded by the harness:
- `openai__openai_check_request`: pass

The agent's validator claims (not proof; graded against the recorded calls):
- openai_check_request: pass (chat.completions body with gpt-5.6-terra and max_completion_tokens: no unknown or deprecated params)

Test of this change: `chat-test3`, written by the agent and run with the checks.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- The test only passes with ts-jest diagnostics off, because of existing type errors: the repo imports creatServiceCustomer, which the Kafka service doesn't export. The repo's own jest config also only matches **/tests/**, so the test sits in src/tests/.
- The repo-wide typecheck already failed before this change. It still fails after it, but one new error is gone, the max_completion_tokens type error that the 4.104.0 bump fixed.
- The 1000-token cap and the lack of an explicit reasoning_effort setting were not tested on real prompts.
- The package.json and package-lock.json changes from the openai bump were not reviewed with diff.
- typecheck was already failing before the change and still fails.
- chat-test was already failing before the change and still fails.
- chat-test2: new failure `FAIL src/tests/chat.service.test.ts`
- chat-test2: new failure `src/openai-chat/src/service/chat.service.ts: error TS2724: '"./../../../common/kafka/node.kafka.service"' has no exported member named 'creatServiceCustomer'. Did you mean 'createServiceCustomer'?`
- chat-test2 was already failing before the change and still fails.

### Behaviour changes

- The model changes from the Completions model to gpt-5.6-terra, a reasoning model, so output, latency and cost will differ.
- temperature 0.7 is no longer sent.
- The token cap rises from 100 to 1000 because it now includes reasoning tokens, so replies may be longer.
- generateText can return null if the message content is null, for example on a refusal.

---

preparation.reasoning: The root package.json has no postinstall, prepare, or codegen scripts. The typecheck (tsc --noEmit) needs only the already-installed dependencies and types. The Docker subfolder services in the README are not part of this check, and no env vars are needed for tsc to run.

review.summary: The visible diff is all package-lock.json churn. The openai range moves from ^4.55.3 to ^4.104.0, a nested ethers/ws entry is added, and resolved/integrity fields are stripped from npm's bundled deps. The diff was truncated at 60k characters, so I cannot see whether src/openai-chat/src/service/chat.service.ts or package.json were changed. The call site at chat.service.ts:17 calls openai.completions.create with model "text-davinci-003" and reads response.choices[0].text. If the replacement gpt-5.6-terra is a chat/responses-only model, a model-string swap is not enough: the call must move to chat.completions.create (or responses.create) and read message.content. I could not confirm gpt-5.6-terra or which endpoints it supports; check the quoted deprecations page and the openai SDK types. On the checks, typecheck is unchanged (29 failures before and after), chat-test2 got worse (1 to 2 failures) and chat-test3 now passes. No check makes a live call to the new model. needs-review is the right grade.

concerns.issue: The visible diff does not show this file changing. Line 17 uses the legacy completions endpoint with text-davinci-003, and lines 24-25 read choices[0].text. If gpt-5.6-terra does not serve /v1/completions, the call must switch to chat.completions.create with messages, and the return should be choices[0].message.content. I could not confirm the model or its endpoint support. If the migration is missing or incomplete, generateText keeps failing at runtime, and the catch block swallows the error and returns null.

The lockfile root entry now says openai ^4.104.0, but package.json as quoted still says ^4.55.3. If package.json was not updated (it is not visible in the truncated diff), `npm ci` will refuse the out-of-sync lockfile.

The lockfile has unrelated churn. resolved/integrity hashes were removed from dozens of node_modules/npm/node_modules/* bundled entries, which weakens integrity checking for those packages. A new nested node_modules/ethers/node_modules/ws@8.17.1 was added. None of this is required by the model retirement, and it suggests the lockfile was regenerated with a different npm version.

chat-test2 went from 1 failure to 2, a regression the PR introduces or exposes. Typecheck still fails with 29 errors, so it cannot show that the new call shape type-checks. No test exercises the live OpenAI call with the new model.

checkFirst: Expand the truncated diff and confirm whether chat.service.ts and package.json were changed at all.

Check the deprecations page and the openai SDK types to confirm gpt-5.6-terra exists and which endpoint it supports (completions vs chat.completions/responses), then confirm the response field the code reads (text vs message.content).
Find out what new failure chat-test2 reports after the change.
Revert the unrelated npm bundled-dependency integrity stripping and the ethers/ws addition in package-lock.json, or explain them.
